(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a __gentle, non-destructive medium__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of __distilled or deionized__ water.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __successively exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least once__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating __and gently agitating__ the shed cellular material.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least once__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises __isolating__ the DNA.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The method of claim 9, wherein said isolating is performed by adding __ferromagnetic__ particles to the shed cellular material. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos in a __quiescent state__ prior to step (c) or (d).

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __selected from genotyping or quantitative PCR__. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on the __results of the molecular analysis__. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more __identified__ embryos. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is __partially or fully automated__.
